{{Top|leg}}
'''Landing Bay 29''' was a standard long-term docking facility located in [[Iritsa Spaceport]]. It was a pit cut into the bedrock, covered by a retractable roof. It was designed for ships needing extensive repairs, and had a small living cubicle on the north side of the bay.
